name: May
summary: The best overall month on this site: every park in full operation, summer crowds still weeks away, and the weather warm without the Texas and Florida extremes.

verdict.short: May at these parks: one of the year's best windows. The best overall month on this site: every park in full operation, summer crowds still weeks away, and the weather warm without the Texas and Florida extremes..
bestFor: Full lineups at calm weekday levels

crowds.shape: The best overall month on this site: every park in full operation, summer crowds still weeks away, and the weather warm without the Texas and Florida extremes.

cost.note: Ticket prices move by date at every park on this site; the level describes the month's overall shape rather than any single day.

planningNotes.heading: The month in one decision
body: The pre-Memorial-Day weekdays are the year's best conditions at the northern parks — full lineups, school in session, weather that finally cooperates.

planningNotes.heading: The detail that matters
body: Memorial Day Saturday is the summer season's opening gun and prices and crowds behave accordingly.

freshness.sourceNote: Crowd and cost shapes describe multi-year patterns across the ten parks rather than a forecast for any single year. Weather figures are climate normals for each region and do not decay; the Texas figures blend the DFW and San Antonio areas, and the Southern California figures blend the coastal and inland valleys.
